_comment: The research lineage diagram. `levels` are ordered oldest-first; the layout renders them bottom-up so each paper sits above the work it grew out of. `roots` is what each thread serves and renders at the bottom; `stage` and the optional `deployment` render at the top. A thread with no `deployment` shows its stage alone. Slugs must match filenames in src/papers/.
intro: Seven papers, three threads. Each thread starts with the people it is for, grows upward through the work, and ends where that work is headed.
